Arthritis Pain Relief with Ginger and Turmeric

Testimonial arthritis ginger turmeric chronic-pain

Evidence: testimonial

Summary

A 62-year-old with osteoarthritis reports significant reduction in morning stiffness and pain after 8 weeks of ginger and turmeric dietary protocol.

Subject Type: remedy

Subject ID: remedy_003

Experience

After 20 years of knee and hand osteoarthritis, my rheumatologist's NSAIDs were causing stomach issues. I started adding fresh ginger and turmeric to my diet daily. Within 8 weeks, my morning stiffness dropped from 45 minutes to under 10, and I could grip objects again without pain. I now use these herbs daily as part of my maintenance routine.

Outcome

Morning stiffness reduced from 45 to under 10 minutes; pain decreased enough to discontinue NSAID use.
